using Xunit;
using LoadEmployees.Mapping;
using LoadEmployees.TestDoubles;

namespace LoadEmployees.Tests;

public class SQL_TruncateTargetStepTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task SQL_TruncateTarget_ExecutesTheStatementInsideTheSharedTransaction()
    {
        using var harness = new PackageHarness();
